seoTitle: Money Heist Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Money Heist test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're the Professor, Berlin, Tokyo, Nairobi, Denver, Lisbon, Palermo or Alicia Sierra — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the one with a plan for everything, the one who acts first and thinks later, or the one who keeps the whole team going? Answer 12 questions about how you really handle plans, pressure and people, and find out which Money Heist character you are.

characters.name: The Professor
characters.title: The Mastermind
characters.summary: You've thought of everything — and you have a plan B for the plan B.
description: Like the Professor, you're happiest when you've planned every detail. Sergio Marquina spent years preparing the Royal Mint heist, working out how the police would react before they'd even arrived.
You're calm, patient and a little awkward around people. You'd rather stay in the background and let the plan do the talking — and your one unbreakable rule is that nobody gets hurt.
Your weak spot is the thing you can't plan for: feelings. Falling for the very inspector hunting him was the one move the Professor never saw coming.
characters.flaw: You trust the plan more than people — until your heart ruins it.
characters.signature: Pushing up your glasses while plan C quietly kicks in.
characters.clashReason: they need to plan every tiny detail and won't let anything happen on the fly

characters.name: Berlin
characters.title: The Charming Narcissist
characters.summary: Elegant, witty and utterly sure of yourself. Rules are for other people.
description: Like Berlin, you have style. Andrés de Fonollosa led the crew inside the Royal Mint with a glass of wine in one hand and a cutting remark ready for anyone who questioned him.
You love the finer things — art, music, a beautiful speech — and you've been in love more times than you can count. Berlin was married five times.
But your charm has a cold edge. You can be cruel when you're bored, and you care far more about being admired than being liked.
strengths: Knows how to make a moment unforgettable
characters.flaw: You think you're the smartest person in every room, and you make sure everyone knows it.
characters.signature: A perfectly timed speech, delivered in a suit that costs more than the room.
characters.clashReason: they're charming right up until they've got what they want

characters.name: Tokyo
characters.title: The Wild Card
characters.summary: You act first and think later — and somehow it usually works out. Usually.
description: Like Tokyo, you run on instinct. Silene Oliveira was on the run after a robbery went wrong when the Professor found her and recruited her. She's also the voice telling the whole story.
You're passionate, fearless and loyal to the people you love. When something feels wrong, you won't sit still and wait for permission.
Your problem is the fuse. You make big decisions in a split second, and sometimes the whole team has to clean up after you.
characters.flaw: You act on impulse, and other people pay for it.
characters.signature: Kicking the door open before anyone's finished explaining the plan.
characters.clashReason: they'll blow up the plan the moment they get bored of it

characters.name: Nairobi
characters.title: The Heart of the Team
characters.summary: Warm, loud and a natural boss. You keep everyone going when it all gets hard.
description: Like Nairobi, you're the one who lifts the room. Ágata Jiménez was the crew's forger and ran quality control at the Royal Mint, keeping the printing presses going.
You're bossy in the best way. When the men started fighting over who was in charge, she took over herself and announced that the matriarchy had begun.
Underneath the energy is a big, soft heart. Everything she did was about getting back to her son, and you'd go to the ends of the earth for your people too.
characters.flaw: You take everyone's problems on as your own.
characters.signature: Rallying the whole team with a pep talk and a list of jobs.
characters.clashReason: they'll take over and start telling everyone what to do

characters.name: Denver
characters.title: The Big-Hearted Hothead
characters.summary: You're loud, emotional and quick to fight — and the first to hug it out afterwards.
description: Like Denver, you feel everything at full volume. Daniel Ramos joined the heist alongside his father, Moscow, and his laugh became as famous as the heist.
You lose your temper fast, but you're never cruel. When he was told to kill a hostage, he couldn't do it — and he ended up falling in love with her instead.
You're protective, honest and a bit of a mess. People always know exactly where they stand with you.
characters.flaw: Your temper gets there before your brain does.
characters.signature: A laugh you can hear from the other side of the building.
characters.clashReason: they'll start shouting before anyone's finished talking

characters.name: Lisbon
characters.title: The Principled Rebel
characters.summary: You're strong, fair and brave. When you believe in something, you'll change your whole life for it.
description: Like Lisbon, you have a strong sense of right and wrong. Raquel Murillo was the police inspector leading the negotiations against the Royal Mint crew.
You're determined and brave, and you don't let anyone push you around. She was the one standing up to her bosses when they tried to push her aside.
But when you realise the people you trusted weren't what they seemed, you're willing to change sides. Raquel went from hunting the Professor to joining him.
characters.flaw: Once your mind is made up, you'll bet everything on it.
characters.signature: Standing your ground in front of the people who think they outrank you.
characters.clashReason: they'll drag you into arguments about what's right when you just want it done

characters.name: Palermo
characters.title: The Proud Perfectionist
characters.summary: Brilliant, dramatic and a total perfectionist. There's a right way to do things — yours.
description: Like Palermo, you're very clever and you know it. Martín Berrote is an Argentine engineer who spent years planning the Bank of Spain heist with his close friend Berlin.
You care about every detail and you can't bear it when people cut corners. Taking command inside the bank was the moment he'd been waiting for.
Your pride is your weak spot. When things go wrong you take it personally, and you'd rather be proven right than get along with anyone.
characters.flaw: Your ego turns small disagreements into big wars.
characters.signature: Drawing the whole plan out from memory, and arguing with anyone who disagrees.
characters.clashReason: they'll turn every small disagreement into a battle about who's right

characters.name: Alicia Sierra
characters.title: The Ruthless Hunter
characters.summary: Sharp, cynical and very, very good at your job. You'll do what it takes to win.
description: Like Alicia Sierra, you're the person people underestimate at their peril. She was the police inspector sent in to deal with the Bank of Spain heist — heavily pregnant and completely unafraid.
You're blunt, sarcastic and hard to rattle. She was ready to use brutal methods that other officers wouldn't, and she didn't lose sleep over it.
But when her own side turned on her, she went her own way — and she gave birth with the Professor helping to deliver her baby. You're tougher than anyone, but not as heartless as you pretend.
characters.flaw: You'll bend any rule if it gets you the win.
characters.signature: A sarcastic smile and a plan nobody else would dare to try.
characters.clashReason: they'll do anything to win, and you don't want to be in the way

questions.text: You're organising a surprise party for a friend. You...

options.text: Plan every detail, including what to do if they find out
Pick a venue so stylish nobody will ever forget it
Throw it together at the last minute. That's half the fun
Rope everyone in and hand out the jobs

questions.text: Someone pushes in front of you in a long queue. You...

options.text: Tell them loudly what you think, then laugh it off
Calmly point to the queue and wait until they move
Say something so cutting they walk to the back themselves
Take it personally and stew about it all day

questions.text: Your team's project is due tomorrow and it's nowhere near finished. You...

options.text: Relax a little. You started a backup version last week
Pull an all-nighter on pure adrenaline
Redo everyone else's part, because it's not good enough
Let the others panic. You'll present it like a masterpiece anyway

questions.text: You've got a week off work to use up. You...

options.text: Fill the house with friends and cook every night
Head to the coast with your mates and do nothing sensible
Go somewhere beautiful for art, wine and long dinners
Don't take it. Time off makes you restless

questions.text: A friend is being ripped off by their landlord. You...

options.text: Help them look up their rights and do it properly
Go round with them and have a loud word
Take charge and sort the whole thing out for them
Write a ten-page complaint, then get annoyed when they don't send it

questions.text: You've got one free evening a week to learn something new. You choose...

options.text: Chess. You love thinking five moves ahead
Kickboxing. You need somewhere to put all that energy
Criminal psychology. You like knowing how people's minds work
Engineering. You want to know exactly how things are built

questions.text: You get caught out in a lie. You...

options.text: Own up. You'd rather deal with it now
Laugh. You were never any good at lying anyway
Tell an even better story
Stay calm and explain it in a way that almost makes sense

questions.text: Your boss asks you to bend a rule "just this once". You...

options.text: Refuse. Rules exist for a reason
Bend it, as long as it gets results
Shrug. You've broken bigger rules than that
Agree, once you've worked out everything that could go wrong

questions.text: You and your friends win some money together. You say...

options.text: Whoever did the most work gets the biggest share
Let's blow it on one unforgettable night out
Put some aside for whoever's struggling
You had the idea, so you'll take a little extra

questions.text: Someone in your group is hiding something that could get you all in trouble. You...

options.text: Find their weak spot and get it out of them
Stand up for them. They're one of yours
Tell them to come clean, or you will
Confront them right there, in front of everyone

questions.text: You're a police detective negotiating with a gang that has taken over a bank. They're winning. You...

options.text: Play it by the book. The hostages' lives come first
Use any dirty trick that works
Stay calm and look for the one thing they didn't plan for
Lose your patience and threaten them down the phone

questions.text: You're part of a crew robbing a bank. The leader has gone quiet and the crew is arguing about who's in charge. You...

options.text: Take charge yourself and get everyone back to work
Take over. You know this plan better than anyone
Remind them who's really in charge. You, obviously
Stay out of it and make sure the hostages are OK
